name: Purple Dragon Wyrmling

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
traits.details: A purple dragon wyrmling that begins its turn in direct sunlight can take only a single standard action on its turn. If it ends the turn in direct sunlight, it burns to ash and is destroyed.

hit.description: damage, and the target takes ongoing 5 psychic damage (save ends)

effect.description: The wyrmling makes two claw attacks.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target takes ongoing 5 psychic damage and is dazed (save ends both).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is not dazed and does not take ongoing damage. Each time the target fails the saving throw against the ongoing effect, the wyrmling can slide it 3 squares
